title: Bag of Bricks - Pink 34
descriptionHtml:
Pink — colour 34

A soft, rosy pink. Gentler than Bubblegum, it suits florals, baby portraits and adding a touch of natural warmth to cheeks and lips.

Works well with: Bubblegum 21, Rouge 38, Cream 20

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Pink bricks (colour 34) for Memobrick mosaics. A soft rosy pink for florals, baby portraits and gentle warmth in skin tones.
